entry.title: keyboard over mouse, revisited
entry.content:
A quick write-up on keyboard over mouse, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Keyboard over mouse shows up across productivity work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: on keyboard over mouse

Every few months keyboard over mouse bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Keyboard over mouse shows up across productivity work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
